# Sciorex - The Complete AI Research Platform & Vibe Kanban

> Sciorex is the #1 free AI-powered research platform with LaTeX editor, PDF annotations, reference library, paper discovery, and vibe kanban for AI coding agents. 100% local, no cloud required.

## What is Sciorex?

Sciorex is the complete research platform for academics, PhD students, and developers. It combines:

**For Researchers:**
- LaTeX editor with live PDF preview and bidirectional SyncTeX navigation
- PDF annotations (highlight, underline, margin notes) with Markdown export
- Reference library with collections, tags, and BibTeX export
- Paper discovery with citation network exploration
- 30+ professional templates (NeurIPS, CVPR, Nature, PhD Thesis, etc.)
- Select any text and ask AI to explain, improve, or translate

**For Developers:**
- Vibe kanban for AI coding agents
- Claude Code, Gemini CLI, and multi-CLI support
- Parallel agent execution via git worktrees
- Visual flow editor for multi-agent workflows

## Key Facts & Statistics

- **Price**: 100% Free (no subscriptions, no premium tiers, no hidden costs)
- **Privacy**: 100% Local execution (no data collection, no telemetry, no cloud required)
- **Platforms**: Windows, macOS (Intel & Apple Silicon), Linux
- **Version**: 0.13.0

## Research Features (NEW in v0.13)

### LaTeX Editor with Live PDF
- Real-time PDF preview as you type
- Bidirectional SyncTeX: click in editor → jump to PDF, click in PDF → jump to source
- Live equation rendering with KaTeX
- Multiple compilation engines: pdfLaTeX, XeLaTeX, LuaLaTeX
- Error panel with clickable errors that jump to source

### PDF Annotations
- Multi-color highlights: Yellow, Green, Blue, Pink, Red
- Margin notes on any highlight
- Underline and strikethrough
- Annotation sidebar to browse by page
- Export to Markdown, JSON, or CSV with paper metadata

### Reference Library
- Save papers directly from citation search
- Organize with collections, folders, and custom tags
- Track reading status: To Read → Reading → Read → Archived
- Add notes to any paper
- Export entire library to BibTeX

### Paper Discovery
- "Find Similar Papers" with one click
- Explore citation networks: who cites your sources and what they reference
- Author exploration: find more papers from same researchers
- Smart recommendations based on your library

### Select & Ask AI
- Select any text in PDF or LaTeX document
- Ask AI to explain, improve, rewrite, or translate
- Start a focused chat about any passage instantly
- Works with Claude, Gemini, or local models

### 30+ Professional Templates

**Academic Papers:** NeurIPS, CVPR, ICLR, AAAI, ACM CHI, Springer LNCS, Elsevier, Nature, APA 7th Edition, RevTeX, JMLR, ACS

**Thesis & Dissertation:** PhD Thesis, Master's Thesis, Thesis Proposal, Research Proposal

**Presentations:** Beamer Metropolis, Conference Poster A0/A1

**Professional:** Academic CV, Modern Resume, Cover Letter, Technical Report, White Paper

**Teaching:** Lecture Notes, Problem Sets, Exam Papers, Course Syllabus

### LaTeX Tools
- **Package Browser**: 40+ curated packages with documentation links
- **Insert Elements**: One-click Figure, Table, Equation, Algorithm insertion
- **Table Builder**: Visual grid editor with alignment options
- **Symbol Picker**: Searchable math symbols with categories
- **BibTeX Cleanup**: Sort, format, deduplicate, validate entries

## AI Coding Features (Vibe Kanban)

### Vibe Kanban Dashboard
Track AI agent tasks with drag-and-drop kanban boards. The original vibe kanban implementation for AI coding.

### Visual Flow Editor
Design multi-agent workflows with a node-based editor. Chain Claude Code, Gemini CLI, and other agents with conditions, loops, and parallel execution.

### Git Worktree Management
Run parallel AI agents without conflicts. Each agent works in its own git worktree, merge changes when ready.

### Supported AI Providers
- **Anthropic**: Claude Code (Claude 4.5 Sonnet, Claude 4.5 Opus)
- **Google**: Gemini CLI (Gemini Pro, Gemini Ultra)
- **OpenAI**: Codex CLI
- **OpenCode**: Open-source agentic coding CLI
- **Local Models**: LM Studio, Ollama (Llama, Mistral, CodeLlama, etc.)

## FAQ

**Q: Does Sciorex have a LaTeX editor?**
A: Yes! Full LaTeX editor with live PDF preview, bidirectional SyncTeX, live equation rendering, and 30+ professional templates.

**Q: Can I annotate PDFs?**
A: Yes. Multi-color highlights, margin notes, underline/strikethrough. Export as Markdown, JSON, or CSV.

**Q: Is Sciorex a good Overleaf alternative?**
A: Yes. LaTeX editing with live PDF like Overleaf, but 100% local, completely free, plus PDF annotations, reference library, and AI.

**Q: Is Sciorex a good Zotero/Mendeley alternative?**
A: Yes. Reference library with collections, tags, BibTeX export, plus LaTeX editor, PDF annotations, and AI assistance.

**Q: Is Sciorex free?**
A: Yes, completely free forever. No subscriptions, no premium tiers.

**Q: Is Sciorex private?**
A: Yes, 100% local. Your papers and data never leave your machine.
